cause: The owned legacy Agent workflow tests still omit active_head_run_id from compiler preconditions, and missing-value subset tests have no confirmed server-owned metadata registry. The exact scoped suite fails before the intended composition, derived-column, survey-design, and execution assertions can run.
impact: 13 tests fail at the current fail-closed contracts; no production authority or metadata boundary is changed.

cause: The data.rename workflow adapter persists its derived data and recipe in the public artifact index but does not admit those result artifacts into the active server-owned workflow artifact registry before a dependent model.genesis step consumes the produced_dataset binding.
impact: The owned suite has 61 passing tests and one preserved execution failure. The fail-closed authority behavior remains intact; no production code or authority check was changed.
lesson: A public artifact-index row is not sufficient evidence for a workflow dependency; every producer result must be admitted into the active receipt-bound server registry before downstream consumption.

cause: The exact owned pytest gate cannot be marked green while the preserved data.rename to model.genesis execution assertion is blocked by missing receipt-bound admission of the data operation result.
impact: The migration contract changes are reviewable, 61 of 62 scoped tests pass, and the remaining integration issue is explicit. Browser, provider, full-host, and release gates remain separate and are not claimed.
lesson: A focused test gate must retain the real downstream execution assertion when the current producer-to-registry bridge is incomplete.
